Bundled Windows x64 FFmpeg essentials (GPL-3.0), fetched by scripts/package-windows.sh.

Pinned: https://github.com/GyanD/codexffmpeg/releases/download/9.0/ffmpeg-9.0-essentials_build.zip
Upstream builds page: https://www.gyan.dev/ffmpeg/builds/

DramaRed copies ffmpeg.exe next to DramaRed.UI.exe so CoverLoader can convert
HEIC/HEIF posters to PNG. The binary itself is gitignored; LICENSE is kept in-tree.
